description: This file implements a data structure and functions for managing a list of object instances in a data model, including cache management, refresh mechanisms, and object lifecycle event notifications.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a dm_instances_vector_t structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and entries to zero.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the vector in a dm_instances_vector_t and resets its fields.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds an object instance to the vector if it does not already exist.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes an object instance and its nested instances from the vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_IsExist
methods.description: Checks if a given object instance exists in the vector, refreshing the cache if needed.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_DoesFirstLevelInstanceExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific top-level instance exists without refreshing.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetNextInstance
methods.description: Calculates the next available instance number for an object given its parent instance numbers.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetNumInstances
methods.description: Counts the number of instances of an object with specific parent instance numbers.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetInstances
methods.description: Retrieves a list of instance numbers for a specific object and parent instance numbers.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_RefreshBaselineInstances
methods.description: Refreshes all object instances at startup to enable notifications for creation/deletion.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_DumpTable
methods.description: Prints the instance cache for a specified top-level object.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Prints all instances in a given instance vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetAllInstancePaths_Unqualified
methods.description: Returns paths of all instances of an unqualified multi-instance object and its children.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetAllInstancePaths_Qualified
methods.description: Returns paths of all instances matching a qualified multi-instance object.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_NextLockPeriod
methods.description: Increments the lock period counter, unlocking cached instances.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_SetRefreshOverride
methods.description: Sets a flag to force refresh of instance cache even if not expired.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_RefreshInstance
methods.description: Adds a specific object instance into the instance vector, called within get_instances_cb.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_SeedInstance
methods.description: Seeds an object instance into the vector immediately after registration, to prevent notifications.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_RefreshTopLevelObjectInstances
methods.description: Refreshes instances for a top-level object and its children.

methods.name: AddObjectInstance
methods.description: Adds an object instance path to a string vector.

methods.name: RefreshBaselineInstances
methods.description: Recursively refreshes all object instances in the data model tree at startup.

methods.name: RefreshInstVector
methods.description: Ensures the instance vector cache is up-to-date, calling vendor callbacks if needed, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: IsExistInInstVector
methods.description: Checks if a specific object instance exists within a given instance vector.

methods.name: AddToInstVector
methods.description: Adds an object instance to an instance vector.
